connect.title: Connection guide
connect.subtitle: Account setup, Kaleidoscope instructions and current stable/lazer compatibility.
connect.accountText: Use the username and password you registered here. Your official osu! account remains separate.
connect.stableText: Choose your stable executable in Kaleidoscope. The launcher supplies Illyaverse's -devserver argument. Close any running game, launch or restart through Kaleidoscope, then sign in with your community account.
connect.toolText: The launcher is configured for Illyaverse. Choose your installed stable or official lazer client and follow the guide to launch or restart. A public download is not available yet; start with the test operation guide.
connect.tlsText: Local testing currently uses illya.test and requires local DNS or hosts routing plus a trusted test certificate, configured by the operator using the local testing guide. With public DNS and valid HTTPS in a production deployment, players do not need to edit hosts.
connect.lazerTitle: Use your installed official lazer client
connect.lazerText: Kaleidoscope temporarily loads the small Transfiguration connection bridge into a supported official lazer client, without rebuilding the whole client. If an official update exceeds the supported version, the launcher stops; wait for and update the compatible launcher and bridge package together.
connect.compatibilityText: The launcher core, connection bridge and server protocols have automated tests. Launching the actual game interface, full stable/lazer gameplay, multiplayer and replays still need native client validation. This remains an experimental test.
connect.restoreText: After a normal game exit, the launcher and guardian clean up the connection DLLs they installed. If the launcher exits unexpectedly, reopen Kaleidoscope and check recovery. Once cleanup is complete, start the game from its usual official shortcut.
